tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Canvas: page, rows, card cells. The ground every other surface sits on. Lime theme is pure black; the landing and promo always use the lime values.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, hover row, hero band, menus inside a card. One step up from background.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inset and pressed: empty meter and timeline tracks, the play and menu buttons at rest.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards (same value as surface).

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs and toasts, always with a border hairline and the 2xl shadow.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills behind secondary content.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary fills.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Bar grid, tact columns and the 16px grid background of the mixer timeline.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text, names, numbers on background, surface, surface-2, card and popover.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Meta, labels and everything the product writes about the content, on background, surface and card. Kept off surface-2 (4.3:1 there).

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: The signature accent: the one action or current state per screen (play, the current section, the playhead, the chord sounding now). Never colours data. Each theme swaps its hue; the name stays.

tokens.name: lime-soft
tokens.usage: Accent wash behind a current item (current section, selected row).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill; equals lime.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary and lime fills (dark in lime, light in the pink and indigo themes). Source pair misses 4.5:1 in Blush Dark (2.6:1) and Studio Paper Dark (3.6:1); kept exact, flagged.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Accent alias for third-party styles; equals lime.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring and focused input border; equals lime.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: dividers, outlines, card cells, ghost buttons at rest. Hairlines are 1.3-1.45:1 against background in every theme: dividers, not affordances. Controls get their meaning from the label text, and hover turns their border lime.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input outline.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors, deletes, storage above 90%. Nothing else.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a destructive fill (danger button). Source pair is about 3.8:1 in every theme (passes only for bold 19px+); kept exact, flagged.

tokens.name: online
tokens.usage: Online, ready, valid input, the SYS OK pulse.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Activity: applied versions (lime family).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Activity: uploads (green).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Activity: versions (blue).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Amber: structure, resources, metadata activity, and stalls ("No movement for 12 weeks"). Always paired with words. In Blush Light the dot is 2.5:1 on background; flagged.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Activity: comments (magenta).

tokens.name: compare-b
tokens.usage: Side B in A/B compare only. Side A is lime.

tokens.name: compare-b-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a compare-b fill. Source pair misses 4.5:1 in Lime (3.1:1), Studio Dim (2.5:1) and Studio Paper (4.3:1); kept exact, flagged.

tokens.name: wave-amber
tokens.usage: Plan and subscription surfaces: grace and warning tone (TONE in components/plan/ui.tsx). Darker in light themes.

tokens.name: wave-mint
tokens.usage: Plan surfaces: information tone.

tokens.name: wave-violet
tokens.usage: Plan surfaces: account override tone.

tokens.name: track-1
tokens.usage: Track, member and space identity colour (TRACK_ICON_SWATCHES in lib/trackIcon.ts, slot 1). Fills avatars and track badges with background-coloured initials; tints a track's waveform. Identifies, never means anything; not tied to an instrument. Same in every theme.

tokens.name: sd-bg
tokens.usage: Landing and promo canvas. Always dark: neither the system preference nor an app theme repaints it.

tokens.name: sd-surface
tokens.usage: Landing panels and cards.

tokens.name: sd-fg
tokens.usage: Landing text on sd-bg and sd-surface.

tokens.name: sd-mute
tokens.usage: Landing small mono text (.sd-k keys) on sd-bg; a step brighter than the app grey so it stays AA.

tokens.name: sd-line
tokens.usage: Landing hairlines.

tokens.name: sd-accent
tokens.usage: Landing lime: playhead, current section, primary CTA, the value line. One lime thing per frame.

tokens.name: sd-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on sd-accent (the CTA).

styles.name: greeting
styles.usage: Spaces hero greeting. Uppercase except the user name; 36px on phones. Class: tb-type-name text-4xl sm:text-6xl uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none.

styles.name: page-name
styles.usage: Space hero and mixer title, as typed (never uppercased). 30px phones, 48px tablet. Class: tb-type-name text-3xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none.

styles.name: card-name
styles.usage: Space card name. Turns lime when the card is hovered.

styles.name: row-name
styles.usage: Project row name; Quick peek drawer title uses 18px.

styles.name: small-name
styles.usage: Member names, track headers, the latest project inside a space card.

styles.name: dialog-title
styles.usage: TbModal heading and error-screen title, uppercase. Class: font-display text-lg uppercase tracking-tight.

styles.name: big-number
styles.usage: StatGrid values, tabular figures; 24px on phones.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Drop a comment on bar 36-40 of the lead vocal.

styles.name: small-body
styles.usage: Activity lines and descriptions, in muted-foreground with the actor in foreground bold.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Uppercase meta under names, toolbars and every button label. The floor for any text a person reads.

styles.name: section-label
styles.usage: SectionLabel above lists and panels, uppercase, muted-foreground.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Only for a label under a number or a marker (stat captions, roadmap stage). Nothing goes below 9px.

styles.name: landing-hero
styles.usage: Landing and ad headlines: Archivo 800, uppercase, clamp(3rem, 10vw, 7rem); a lime full stop may close the line.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Promo display, uppercase. Not used inside the app.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Promo display, uppercase; also the four version verbs.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: No laptop. No DAW. Just structure, chords, and a metronome you can trust.

styles.name: landing-value
styles.usage: .sd-v: the value beside a key, in sd-fg.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Gap between waveform pills (gap-[2px]); 3px on phones.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps in toggles, row action gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline gaps, meta gaps, menu item padding (py-2).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding (px-3), row vertical padding (py-3), stat cell padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding (px-4); the 16px micro grid and the landing phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Space card padding (p-5) and its block gaps (mb-5, mt-5).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Header and footer side padding (px-6), dialog padding (p-6), stat cell padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Error-screen card padding; the landing desktop gutter.

tokens.name: grid-master
tokens.usage: Master grid of brand backgrounds.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: App header height (h-14); landing header is 48px on phones, 56px from 992px.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum size of anything tapped on a phone: play, Quick peek, the menu button, M/S.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for everything: cards, buttons, inputs, avatars, dialogs. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: The base --radius (0.125rem); barely softens a corner where a component library needs one.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Listed in the kit; not used by product components.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Listed in the kit; not used by product components.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Only waveform pills, status dots and the volume knob.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: shadow-2xl: menus, popovers, dialogs, drawers, toasts. Nothing that sits in the page flow casts a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-playhead
tokens.usage: The playhead hairline glow (in themes: the theme lime).

tokens.name: z-footer
tokens.usage: StatusFooter.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: AppHeader and in-card menus.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: SideDrawer (Quick peek, Plan).

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: FloatingPopover and TbSelect lists.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: TbModal.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast.

tokens.name: z-tooltip
tokens.usage: HoverTooltip.
